topSignals.title: Ceres Power extends rally on Weichai Power SOFC ramp-up signal.
topSignals.text: Ceres shares gained ~22% this week (third straight week of double-digit gains, ~1,000% over one year) after Goldman Sachs lifted its price target to a Street-high 670p, citing faster-than-expected SOFC ramp-up signals from Weichai Power, which holds exclusive China manufacturing rights to Ceres' stack technology. Momentum traces back to Bloom Energy's raised full-year outlook. Bloomberg / TradingView

topSignals.title: PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement — the ~60 GW capacity shortfall auction — is scheduled to begin in September 2026
topSignals.text: , per PJM's public filings; requested tariff effective date remains October 12. This is the mechanism most likely to reshape near-term economics for behind-the-meter/on-site generation (SOFC included) serving PJM-territory data centers. Day Pitney / FERC

topSignals.title: Elcogen and Topsoe: no new dated announcements in the last 24-48h.
topSignals.text: Elcogen's latest public output remains an insight/thought-leadership piece on clean-energy scaling as industrial strategy (no new product, capacity, or partnership news since the E3000 G2 platform launch and the JNK India MoU). Status explicitly logged per standing instruction. Elcogen News / Topsoe News

lcoe.text: EIA August 2026 STEO Henry Hub revision (confirmed figures): 2026 Henry Hub spot price forecast cut to $3.44/MMBtu (from $3.67 in July STEO, >6% reduction); near-term prices expected to stay below $3.00/MMBtu until November, averaging $3.03/MMBtu over the remaining five months of 2026; Q4 2026 average projected at $3.57/MMBtu; 2027 annual average projected at $3.49/MMBtu. This refines (with harder numbers) the STEO revision flagged qualitatively on August 22 - recommend using these figures directly in the gas-price input for the LCOE model.
Germany EnEfG easing: still no updated figures beyond the August 23 flag.
Unverified lead (not yet actionable): hybrid SOFC system design reporting LCOE of $0.155/kWh at 66.3% electrical efficiency - needs primary-source confirmation before use.

Pending carry-forward list unchanged from August 24 (NM Supreme Court/Project Jupiter, PJM Expedited Interconnection Track, PJM BYONG/Large Load Registry, FERC RM26-4, Bloom 10-Q/class-action dates, Ceres H1 results, Bloom Q3 earnings, Rolls-Royce SMR GDA, Germany EnEfG timeline).
